anomalies.description: Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat using sticks and fists in a narrow indoor corridor; at least four participants are actively fighting, with others observing or moving into the scene.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat in a narrow corridor; at least two pairs are actively fighting, with one man in a white tank top and another shirtless man exchanging blows and grappling, while others nearby also fight or intervene.

A shirtless man is pinned against a doorframe by two opponents (one in white tank top, one in white t-shirt) and appears to be struck repeatedly while unable to effectively defend himself, indicating a lopsided assault on a temporarily helpless victim.; A man in a white t-shirt intervenes and strikes the shirtless man who was previously being pushed, appearing to subdue or assault him while he is off-balance; the victim shows no effective resistance.
Two shirtless men engage in close-quarters physical combat near a doorway; one is pushing or striking the other against the wall while a third man in a white tank top observes closely.

A person in a white tank top is seen from behind, facing a door; another person's arm enters frame from the right and appears to strike or push the door, while the main subject raises their arm defensively or in preparation to engage. In frame f2 (17.0s), a metal bar is visible protruding from the door, suggesting forced entry or resistance during physical confrontation.; Multiple individuals are involved in a chaotic scuffle inside a confined space with barred doors; at least two pairs appear to be grappling, with one person holding a stick-like object.

Multiple individuals are densely packed in a confined space with barred partitions (likely a cell or holding area). There is chaotic movement, overlapping bodies, and apparent struggle—some individuals appear restrained or pinned down, while others lean over them. The scene suggests collective violent unrest or group clashes within an enclosed facility.

In the crowded cell-like setting, one individual (center-left, wearing light shirt) appears to be held down or immobilized by multiple others, while another person leans over them in a dominant posture. The victim’s posture suggests helplessness, and the surrounding individuals’ actions indicate targeted aggression rather than mutual combat.

A seated individual in a dark uniform is restrained and threatened by two standing individuals in white shirts, one of whom holds a long firearm pointed at the seated person's head/upper body; the seated person appears helpless and does not resist.

A person in a white shirt is seen holding and aiming a long firearm (appears to be a shotgun or rifle) directly at a seated individual in a dark uniform, with the barrel pointed at close range; the posture and alignment strongly indicate an imminent or ongoing shooting.
